objective: replace synchronous 4072-byte MEMORY_WRITE fan-out for proven upload-only allocations while preserving strict transport for GPU-writable or unknown allocations

eligibility.required_binding: one or more buffers with only GPU-read-only usage bits
eligibility.bind_after_map_guard: GPU-writable buffer and every image binding into an active mirror fail before native bind

mirror.lifetime: one eligible active VkMapMemory through VkUnmapMemory
mirror.publication: client release fence before Flush or Submit; service acquire fence before dirty reconciliation
mirror.fd_lifetime: SCM_RIGHTS only during setup; both peers close the descriptor after establishing their mappings
mirror.native_mapping: service owns one whole-allocation native mapping and applies the requested subrange offset locally
mirror.baseline: one private byte-exact snapshot detects host-diverged spans; only those spans copy mirror to native

ownership: device and device-memory IDs retain their typed wire tags
memory must be live, host-visible, upload-only, and owned by the exact device
generation must match the one active mapping
every range must stay inside the original mapped subrange
free-memory and destroy-device fail while a mirror is active

coherent_upload.explicit_flush: one metadata RPC copies only the caller range and advances its baseline
coherent_upload.submit: after typed submit validation and before native queue submission, host-diverged spans from eligible same-device mirrors are copied locally
coherent_upload.device_to_host_visibility: only explicit Invalidate in E077; resource-scoped completion tracking is deferred

noncoherent_upload.explicit_flush: one metadata RPC copies the exact caller span and performs the minimally atom-expanded native Flush
noncoherent_upload.explicit_invalidate: one metadata RPC performs the minimally atom-expanded native Invalidate and copies the exact caller span back
noncoherent_upload.non_coherent_atom_size_source: native physical-device properties retained with the logical device

uncertain_transport.setup_or_unmap_transport_or_protocol_fai: permanently poison the client connection and close its socket
uncertain_transport.unmap_local_mapping_release: always after request initiation, including lost acknowledgement

corruption_contract: zero generation, wrong typed IDs, zero or oversized range, and arithmetic overflow fail protocol encoding or decoding
wrong-size, unsealed, capacity-mutable, or write-sealed setup descriptors fail before native mapping
stale generation, cross-device ownership, out-of-range metadata, duplicate mapping, and cap exhaustion fail closed

verification.strict_fake: retains exact old 4072-byte chunk behavior and opcode 49/48 identity
verification.eligible_coherent_fake: observes host-diverged upload reaching native memory at Submit without opcode 48
verification.gpu_writable_hybrid: TRANSFER_DST plus SHADER_DEVICE_ADDRESS memory maps through strict opcode 49/48; an unsafe buffer bind and every image bind after shared Map are rejected
verification.eligible_noncoherent_fake: proves Map does not read native, partial maintenance expands 257+7 only to 256+256, Submit and Unmap do not flush, and explicit Invalidate pulls
verification.unmap_lost_ack: proves local munmap, permanent poison, and a subsequent Vulkan call with zero new exchanges
source_audited_not_live_injected: wrong setup FD size and seal combinations
verification.unrelated_fake_isolation: external-memory receiver E036/E037/E038/E041 retains fixed fake-buffer identity outside explicit mirror mode; EOF is now a bounded diagnostic instead of a busy loop

reuse: The required deja query found no indexed implementation. E077 reuses E034's mapped-memory lifecycle and exact fake-driver contract, Decision 0003's bounded shared-data-plane direction, E014's sealed-size memfd and release/acquire discipline, E042's setup-only SCM_RIGHTS transport, E060's typed ownership, and E075/E075a's strict/shared fail-closed setup model.
deferred: resource/submission-scoped GPU completion tracking for coherent device-to-host visibility
directly shared native allocations or fault/write interception for general mapped memory
real-workload eligible allocation count and timing
scope: Host upload-transport contract only; no Activity/APK/launcher change, push, merge, tablet deployment, visible frame, Tomb Raider run, benchmark, or FPS claim
